prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: raster exploration for a hand-redrawn vector mascot, three draft variations on one landscape contact sheet.
Primary request: Monad Pet, a lovable hungry virtual pet on Monad. Explore the chosen two-toothed purple dumpling creature direction. Three visibly different original variations of the SAME simple round pet, evenly spaced left to right, isolated on plain white. No wordmark or text.
Subject: Small squat round purple body, two huge ivory eyes with dark plum pupils, a wide little dark mouth with two blunt ivory teeth, tiny soft feet; friendly and slightly needy, never scary. Variation one smooth oval dumpling, variation two softly squared handheld-toy dumpling with a small off-center tuft, variation three pear-shaped dumpling. The eyes must dominate. No ears or horns. No arms or props.
Style: flat clean vector-like shapes, thick soft dark plum outline, confident minimal geometry, charming retro handheld game character. A mark that reads at 32 pixels. No shading, gradients, 3D, texture, extra accessories, small patterns, sparkles, shadows, watermark or existing character references.
Palette: Monad purple #836EF9, dark plum #29213F, ivory #FFF9EF, blush #FFC9DA. Keep body purple in every variation. Each silhouette and two-toothed mouth should be very clear. Lots of white space.
